info.title: JobPilot Candidate API
info.description: The candidate surface of /api/v1 (Stage 14, ADR-0013, ADR-0028): recommendations, job detail, match analysis, applications and the folder, interviews, notifications, the profile summary, the analytics summary and the ATS ruleset lookup. Authenticated by API key (Bearer). Every error is the structured envelope. Version 1.1.0 (2026-09-05) added the mobile client operations - see x-changelog; every 1.0.0 operation and shape is unchanged. This document is FROZEN: docs/api/openapi.candidate.v1.lock records its hash and a test fails when they disagree; a breaking change is version 2, never an edit. No operation submits an application without the applicant's own instruction (ADR-0016).

x-changelog.change: Frozen: thirteen operations for the candidate surface.

Additive, for the mobile client (ADR-0013 step 3): device sign-in and sign-out (a device API key), PATCH /v1/me, consents, saved jobs (and `saved` on JobDetail), a signed document link, the evidence vault read-only, the `unavailable` error code. Nothing removed or changed in meaning. Every object schema is now closed (additionalProperties: false) and every operation documents 401 and 429; the two allOf compositions (JobDetail, ApplicationDetail) are flattened to the same effective shape.

apiKey.description: A JobPilot API key (jp_live_... or jp_test_...). Scopes: read for every GET; apply:write for the two POSTs.

applicationMode.description: Approved Auto-Apply is not a value this field can hold (ADR-0016).

saved.description: v1.1: whether the caller saved this posting.

atsSubmittable.description: True only when the employer has authorised a programmatic submission AND the applicant's mode permits it; the POST .../submit is refused otherwise.

value.description: Always empty when decision is never.

prefix.description: The key prefix (jp_live_...), safe to display; never the secret.

current.description: True for the key that made the request.

DeviceSignIn.description: The applicant's own sign-in: password, or a Supabase Auth access token where the deployment has an identity provider (ADR-0004). Mints a device key of kind device with scope write (read + apply:write; never admin), expiring in 90 days, revoked by the owner, by a password change, or by sign-out-everywhere. At most 10 devices; the least recently used is recycled.

token.description: The bearer credential, returned exactly once. Keep it in platform secure storage.

onboarded.description: False until the applicant completed onboarding on the web (profile, consents).

version.description: The version a grant records today.

granted.description: An unrevoked grant of the current version exists.

available.description: False while the purpose cannot be recorded (cross-border AI processing waits on L-3).

required.description: Required to hold an account; withdrawn only by closing it, on the web.

activeState.description: Stage 06: closed only when no source still lists it; unknown is shown as unconfirmed.

url.description: Absolute; the signature is the authorisation, bound to the owner and the document; ten minutes.

claim.description: The one sentence the applicant approved; never the structured facts.
